transcript.text: Let me search for the SailPoint ISC access request API tools.

Here's how to submit an access request via the ISC API.

## Endpoint

```
POST https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/v3/access-requests
```

## Required OAuth Scopes

- `idn:access-request:manage` — to request access on behalf of another user (admin)
- `idn:access-request-self:manage` — for self-service requests only

## Request Body

```json
{
  "requestedFor": ["<identity-id>"],
  "requestedItems": [
    {
      "type": "ACCESS_PROFILE",
      "id": "<access-profile-id>",
      "comment": "Needed for project X onboarding"
    }
  ],
  "requestType": "GRANT_ACCESS",
  "clientMetadata": {
    "requestedAppName": "MyApp",
    "requestedAppId": "2c91808f7892918f0178b78da4a305a1"
  }
}
```

### Key fields

| Field | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `requestedFor` | Yes | Array of identity IDs to grant access to |
| `requestedItems` | Yes | Array of access items; each needs `type` and `id` |
| `requestedItems[].type` | Yes | `ACCESS_PROFILE`, `ROLE`, or `ENTITLEMENT` |
| `requestedItems[].id` | Yes | The ID of the access profile / role / entitlement |
| `requestedItems[].comment` | No | Business justification comment |
| `requestType` | No | `GRANT_ACCESS` (default) or `REVOKE_ACCESS` |
| `clientMetadata` | No | Key/value pairs passed through to approval workflows |

## Example (curl)

```bash
curl -X POST "https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/v3/access-requests" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {access_token}" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "requestedFor": ["2c918084660f45d6016617daa9210584"],
    "requestedItems": [
      {
        "type": "ACCESS_PROFILE",
        "id": "2c9180835d2e5168015d32f890ca1581",
        "comment": "Required for Q3 project access"
      }
    ],
    "requestType": "GRANT_ACCESS"
  }'
```

**Tip:** The `requestedFor` and `requestedItems[].id` values must be ISC internal IDs (UUIDs), not names. Use `GET /v3/identities` and `GET /v3/access-profiles` (or `/v3/roles`, `/v3/entitlements`) to look up IDs first.

The request will enter any approval workflows configured in ISC before access is provisioned.

```answer-summary
  - method: POST
    path: /v3/access-requests
    api_version: v3
auth_flow: OAuth2 bearer token
required_scopes: [idn:access-request:manage, idn:access-request-self:manage]
key_parameters: [requestedFor, requestedItems, requestedItems[].type, requestedItems[].id, requestedItems[].comment, requestType, clientMetadata]
```
